purpose: Test finite, falsifiable obligations at six boundaries of a source-review route; do not estimate prevalence, causal benefit, authorship or economic effect.
aims: Define the six gates and their typed failure states.
Fix scale, numerical and identity semantics prospectively.
Specify a future Decisive Study before its data exist.

gates.name: source admission
gates.input: finite source bytes, declared language, logical path and finite resource budget
gates.pass: an IntakeRecord binds raw and normalised hashes, UTF-8 text and physical lines
gates.fail: typed refusal; no substitute bytes or silent decoding repair
invariants: file identity checked before and after read

gates.name: observation availability
gates.pass: one of observed, not_applicable, insufficient_evidence or unavailable; observed iff value is non-null
gates.fail: state/value mismatch or missing typed reason

gates.name: value and codomain conformance
gates.input: an observation under a versioned specification
gates.pass: atomic finite value, unit, codomain and measurement scale match the specification
gates.fail: domain, bound, unit or scale violation
invariants: McCabe-style C is ordinal in specification 1.2.0

gates.name: source-evidence adequacy
gates.input: evidence identifiers bound to normalised source and coordinates
gates.pass: structural evidence admission and, where required, coordinate coverage of all visited spans
gates.fail: unknown evidence, wrong scope or uncovered visited span
invariants: structural validity is not treated as coordinate completeness

gates.name: policy interpretation
gates.input: observed value, accepted profile identity and applicable rule
gates.pass: versioned non-compensatory decision vector with declared threshold set
gates.fail: profile mismatch, undeclared threshold or non-applicable rule treated as a decision
invariants: endpoint reduction applies only to monotone x>t

gates.name: consumer admission and source replay
gates.input: producer record, consumer schema/identifier grammar and declared source/profile/build for replay
gates.pass: accepted envelope or replay agreement; aliases preserve original source identity
gates.fail: typed rejection, replay mismatch or identity loss

estimands.name: gate outcome vector
estimands.definition: ordered vector of PASS/typed FAIL states for G1–G6
estimands.decision_rule: each retained witness must show its declared predecessor PASS and target FAIL

estimands.name: threshold projection agreement
estimands.definition: equality of full-interval and stored-level three-state projection
estimands.estimator: exact proportion over enumerated audit grid
estimands.population_claim: general proposition supported additionally by proof

estimands.name: callable oracle agreement
estimands.definition: exact equality of decision count, C=1+d and nesting plus coordinate coverage
estimands.estimator: exact finite agreement count from P3 generated domain
estimands.decision_rule: all generated admitted cases must agree
estimands.population_claim: none beyond generated domain and proof obligations

estimands.name: identity metamorphic agreement
estimands.definition: record_id invariance and measurement_digest change under content-only mutation

estimands.name: numeric comparison status
estimands.decision_rule: decimal equality is inclusive; indeterminate binary64 is not PASS

estimands.name: incremental adjudicated defect detection
estimands.definition: share of adjudicated boundary defects detected by six-gate B2 and missed by strongest comparator B1
estimands.estimator: paired project-clustered estimate in future Decisive Study
estimands.decision_rule: pilot continuation requires at least four unique adjudicated detections

design.current: finite retrospective diagnostic and conformance case
design.sampling_current: purposive generated and curated cases; no probability sample

decision_rules: Every required formal obligation is conjunctive: one counterexample fails it.
Every retained executable claim must reach SV2 before final submission.
Historical CE09/CE11 quantities cannot support a principal claim without exact restoration.
No p-value or population interval is computed from assertions, transformations or profiles.
Indeterminate numerical boundaries are not passes.
multiplicity: No null-hypothesis family is tested in the current finite conformance protocol. All named obligations are reported and none is selected after outcome. The future study has one primary estimand and predeclared secondary estimands.
stopping_current: Run the fixed enumerated obligations to completion; no early stopping after favourable results.
abandonment_current: A failed scale, identity, source-cover or threshold obligation requires repair or claim reduction; no expected output, threshold, seed or baseline may be changed to obtain a pass.
ethics: No human participants, personal data or intervention are used in Phase 6. The future study requires an ethics determination before recruiting adjudicators as research participants.
